# About SIJ Group
SIJ – Slovenian Steel Group is one of the leading producers of stainless steel and special steels in Europe. We are Slovenia's largest vertically integrated metallurgy group. We are committed to global and European climate goals and operate in line with circular economy principles. With our steel and steel products, we are the right partner for facilitating the green transition. Our manufacturing companies are modern recycling steelworks with sustainable production certified by ResponsibleSteel. Our steel is recycled.

# Vertical Integration
The vertical integration of SIJ Group companies enables us to meet customer needs more comprehensively. In terms of steel processes, it can be understood as a closed circle of economic management between companies in the business areas of raw material (steel scrap) collection, steel production and processing into steel products, and processing and distribution to customers.
![Programme scheme: vertically integrated business model](https://cms.sij.si/storage/images/a6f94ca9-fb99-40fa-8d3b-635b95c61428.jpg)
# Leading Market Shares
We are specialists in high value-added steels. The steel range is organised into 10 product brands.
# Key Industries
Steel is the most used material in the world.
  * Mechanical engineering
  * Automotive
  * Oil and gas
  * Power generation
  * Domestic appliances


With our steels and steel products, we are a reliable partner for green breakthrough. We develop and produce steels with a lower carbon footprint:
  * e-mobility: reducing emissions through lighter car and freight vehicle construction, the use of steel to make fuel cells in electric vehicle engines, and the use of steels for electric motor cores for electric vehicle drivetrains and battery casings for electric vehicles,
  * sustainable renewable energy: building turbines to generate energy from renewable sources such as wind, water and ground heat,
  * building nuclear reactors for existing and experimental technologies, e.g. fusion, fission.


Responsible buyers choose steel with a reduced carbon footprint.

# Living Circular Economy
At the SIJ Group, steel can be recycled again and again and processed into new types of steel without any loss of quality. We produce it entirely from steel scrap and have been living a circular economy for almost 40 years.
[![](https://cms.sij.si/storage/gcJELrZrOWZTYZ7ktd2woe3VfwVL5vZKwaotpJY3.jpg)](https://cms.sij.si/storage/gcJELrZrOWZTYZ7ktd2woe3VfwVL5vZKwaotpJY3.jpg)
This is also made possible by the vertical integration of our companies, through the collection and processing of steel scrap, the production of steel from the scrap collected, the processing and distribution, which also includes the return of scrap to production.

# SIJ GROUP RECEIVED THE "PURCHASING PRACTICE OF THE YEAR 2024" AWARD
17.05.2024
Press release
Portorož, 16 May 2024 – **Planet GV and the Slovenian Purchasing Association announced the recipients of the "Purchasing Practice of the Year 2024" award at the Procurement Conference 2024.****The award recipient is SIJ Group for the "Introduction of Procurement Category Management" practice.**
The jury recognised the excellence and innovation of SIJ Group's approach to structured procurement category management, which has contributed to increased efficiency and cost reduction. By introducing this practice, SIJ Group has demonstrated that an innovative approach can achieve outstanding measurable and sustainable results.
  
**Upon receiving the award** , Marjana Drolc Kaluža, Chief Procurement Officer at SIJ Group, stated: "At SIJ Group, the largest steel group in Slovenia, we manage a procurement volume of EUR 500 million._The introduction of category management represents a turning point in the development of procurement. Through a strategic approach to procurement, the company has achieved significant improvements in cost efficiency, productivity, transparency, and supplier relations. Today, 40% of procurement categories are managed through a new digital platform. We have doubled the range of possible and tested substitutes. We have clearly defined strategic, tactical, and operational tasks. Category management is now a key element of SIJ Group's procurement function, allowing procurement as a strategic function to play an even more important role in achieving SIJ Group's business results. Behind it all is a team of 50 dedicated procurement officers. I dedicate the 2024 Purchasing Practice of the Year Award to the entire team."_
Marjana Drolc Kaluža also highlighted that, by introducing procurement category management, SIJ Group has improved cost optimisation, increased transparency, simplified processes, and fostered closer collaboration with suppliers. The introduction of new digital solutions, such as the Cirtuo platform for strategy development and category management, and the Oracle system for the transactional part, has significantly contributed to the optimisation and automation of procurement processes.
All these changes were supported by a reorganisation of procurement, where strategic, tactical, and operational tasks were separated. The introduction of category management has enhanced market and supplier knowledge, enabling faster and better decisions and reducing supplier risks. 
SIJ Group has demonstrated that procurement as a strategic function can significantly contribute to the company's business results. The "Purchasing Practice of the Year 2024" award recognises the efforts and commitment of the entire procurement team.

### Management board and extended management
![](https://www.sij-americas.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcms.sij.si%2Fstorage%2F1276%2FAndrey-Zubitskiy_p.png&w=640&q=75)
dr. Andrey Zubitskiy
President of the Management Board
Andrey Zubitskiy has a PhD in economics. He became the President of the Supervisory Board of SIJ d.d. in 2007, and in January 2017 he was appointed as President of the Management Board of SIJ d.d. Following the expiry of his first term of office, the Supervisory Board reappointed Mr Zubitskiy as President of the Management Board for an additional six-year term from 18 July 2023.
![](https://www.sij-americas.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcms.sij.si%2Fstorage%2F2925%2FSpletna_stran.jpg&w=640&q=75)
dr. Kristijan Bauer
Member of the Management Board, Chief Restructuring Officer
Kristijan Bauer holds a Ph.D. in Engineering and a Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from RWTH Aachen University in Germany. He completed executive education programs at the Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University in the USA and at INSEAD Business School in France. He has 30 years of management experience in industrial companies, where he led complex restructuring processes in crisis situations. He has held senior executive positions and governance roles in Europe, the United States, China and South America, including in companies such as Continental AG, Festo SE and Rosenberger Hochfrequenztechnik GmbH.
![](https://www.sij-americas.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcms.sij.si%2Fstorage%2F1358%2FIgor-Malevanov-\(1\)_p.png&w=640&q=75)
Igor Malevanov
Member of the Management Board, Chief Financial Officer
Igor Malevanov holds a degree in economics. During his studies, he specialized in insurance and financial matters. Since 2001, he has served as Chief Financial Officer and Head of Finance in various metallurgical companies. From 2007 to 25 June 2017, he was responsible for the financial, economic, and IT areas at the SIJ Group. He was reappointed as a Member of the Management Board of SIJ d.d. on 22 February 2018. On May 1, 2020, he became its Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. On December 1, 2025, he was reappointed as a Member of the Management Board responsible for Finance, Controlling, Accounting, and IT.
![](https://www.sij-americas.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcms.sij.si%2Fstorage%2F1356%2FTibor-%C5%A0imonka_p.png&w=640&q=75)
Tibor Šimonka
Executive Vice President
He graduated from the Faculty of Economics at the University of Ljubljana. Throughout his career, he has held numerous leadership positions in various companies, including Slovenske železarne d.d. From 2002 to 2014, he served as the President of the Management Board of SIJ d.d. and Slovenske železarne (now SIJ Group), and from 2016 to February 2019, he was the President of the Management Board of Perutnina Ptuj. He became a member of the Management Board of SIJ d.d. on February 22, 2018, and has been its Senior Vice-president since May 1, 2020. On May 5, 2021, he was elected President of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Slovenia (GZS) for a two-year term. On May 17, 2023, he was re-elected for another term. He serves in this role on a non-professional basis.

# Invitation to vote on the proposed Resolutions of the SIJ9 Noteholders
Based on the provisions of the Rules of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange, d.d., Ljubljana and applicable legislation, the company SIJ – Slovenska industrija jekla, d.d., Gerbičeva ulica 98, Ljubljana (hereinafter: SIJ d.d.) hereby publishes the following documents in the attachment:
1. the consent request letter (the “Request”) from SIJ d.d. to NLB d.d. as security agent under the ICA (as defined in the Request) dated 7 April 2026; and
2. a voting form relating to the Request (the” Voting Form”).
As set out in the Request and as announced by SIJ d.d. on 1 April 2026 on the SEOnet website (http://seonet.ljse.si/) and its own website, GLAS Trust Corporation Limited as the Common Representative under the SIJ9 Notes and the Notes Agent under the ICA is required to obtain the consent of the required majority of the holders of SIJ9 Notes (in their capacity of the Pari Passu Noteholders under the ICA) to the resignation of SIJ Americas, Inc. as a Debtor in accordance with Clause 14.8 of the ICA on the terms set out in the Request, and notwithstanding that it continues to owe liabilities which the ICA defines as Intra-Group Liabilities. 
Accordingly, SIJ d.d. hereby invites each person, who is a holder of any SIJ9 Notes at the end of the day on 8 April 2026, to print out and complete the Voting Form and return it by e-mail to the following addresses: tes@glas.agency, tom.vanson@glas.agency and a copy to project-sava@jadek-pensa.si, igor.malevanov@sij.si, sandi.svetek@sij.si pursuant to Request ideally by 16 April 2026, whereas all votes received by 21 April 2026 will be accepted. Likewise, the holders of SIJ9 Notes may address any questions relating to this announcement or the attached documents to the specified e-mail addresses. 
The information contained in the announcement will be available on the official website of SIJ d.d. at [www.sij.si](http://www.sij.si/) for at least 5 years from the date of publication.
The Management Board of SIJ d.d.
Attachments: [the Request](https://cms.sij.si/storage/2437/SIJ-Americas---ICA-consent-letter-request_VSent-\(002\).pdf) the [Voting Form](https://cms.sij.si/storage/2438/Glasovnica---Voting-form.pdf)
Ljubljana, 8. 4. 2026

# Notice of voting by SIJ9 Noteholders
Based on the provisions of the Rules of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange, d.d., Ljubljana and applicable legislation, the company SIJ – Slovenska industrija jekla, d.d., Gerbičeva ulica 98, Ljubljana (hereinafter: SIJ d.d. or the Issuer) in connection with the published invitation for voting hereby informs that the holders of 343 SIJ9 Notes, representing a total nominal amount of slightly more than 86% of the nominal amount of all SIJ9 issued Notes, have voted to amend the terms and conditions of the SIJ9 Notes (hereinafter: SIJ9 Notes) which would allow the subsidiary SIJ Americas, Inc. to obtain a secured loan of up to 30 million US dollars (USD). 
Holders of 341 SIJ9 Notes have also consented to the termination of the obligations of the company SIJ Americas, Inc. under the ICA (as defined in the terms and conditions of the SIJ9 Notes). Once the other conditions for the validity of the amendment SIJ9 Notes Conditions have been met, the Issuer will inform the public accordingly.
The published information will also be available online at [www.sij.si](http://www.sij.si/) for a period of no less than 5 years.
The Management Board of SIJ d.d.

# Publication of information relating to the notes and the Inter Creditor Agreement
Based on the provisions of the Rules of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange, d.d., Ljubljana and applicable legislation, the company SIJ – Slovenska industrija jekla, d.d., Gerbičeva ulica 98, Ljubljana (hereinafter: SIJ d.d. or the Issuer) in connection with the terms and conditions of the notes issued by the company SIJ - Slovenska industrija jekla, d.d. hereby informs that its subsidiary SIJ Americas, Inc., with business place in the United States of America (hereinafter “SIJ Americas”), wishes to enter into a senior secured revolving credit facility on a borrowing base structure (the “US Facility”) with a third-party financing provider (the “US Lender”) (the borrowing of the US Facility hereinafter also the “Transaction”). 
The proceeds from the Transaction will be used to:
(i) fund ongoing working capital requirements and general corporate purposes of SIJ Americas;
(ii) provide liquidity to SIJ d.d. and its other subsidiaries (the “Group”), including through the repayment of existing loans and past due payables; and 
(iii) pay fees and expenses related to the Transaction. 
As a condition to the US Facility, the US Lender will, among other things, require that SIJ Americas grants a first‑ranking, perfected security interest (the “US Security”) over all of SIJ Americas’ existing and future tangible and intangible assets and the US Lender will also require proof that no other security exists over such assets.
Contractual documentation which is binding on the members of the Group and the terms and conditions of the notes with security code SIJ9 (ISIN: SI0032105247) (the “Notes“) provide for certain restrictions which affect the carrying-out of the Transaction, as follows: 
(i) Condition 7.2 of the Notes restricts granting security by the members of the Group for the benefit of third parties; and 
(ii) SIJ Americas is a party to the ICA, (as defined in the terms and conditions of the Notes) as a Debtor and is therefore required in the near future to grant security over its main assets for the benefit of the holders of the Notes and the other beneficiaries of the security under the ICA.
Therefore, in order to enable SIJ Americas to enter into the US Facility, SIJ d.d. intends in the near term to invite the holders of the Notes to vote on an amendment of the terms and conditions of the Notes to allow the granting by SIJ Americas of security securing its liabilities under the US Facility with the principal amount up to US$30 million and to take such steps as may be necessary to release SIJ Americas from its obligations under the ICA.
In accordance with Condition 1.6 of the Notes the Issuer simultaneously publishes the text of the ICA as currently in force.
The published information will also be available online at [www.sij.si](http://www.sij.si/) for a period of no less than 5 years.
Attachment: [ICA – version in force](https://cms.sij.si/storage/2433/Project-Sava---ICA_Execution-Version_Signed.pdf)

# SIJ Acroni restores narrow-gauge electric locomotive OE-VI
Jesenice, Tuesday, 22 October 2024 – **At a ceremonial opening, SIJ Acroni presented the restored OE-VI locomotive, one of the last narrow-gauge electric locomotives that operated within the company and, earlier, at the former Jesenice Ironworks (Železarna Jesenice and Carniolan Industrial Company (Kranjska industrijska družba). The locomotive is an important part of the technical heritage and history of the steel industry in Jesenice, and now stands in its restored form in front of the former rolling mill at Javornik. From one side, it greets visitors to the company, and from the other, it welcomes passengers traveling by train.**
The OE-VI locomotive was a product of the expertise of in-house specialists who built it in the Jesenice Ironworks locomotive workshops back in 1950, based on the model of its sister locomotive, OE-II. From 1950 to 1974, it operated on the factory’s narrow-gauge track between Jesenice and Javornik, transporting billets from the Siemens-Martin steel plant to be rolled in the heavy rolling mill. On 2 April 1974, the narrow-gauge railway connection to Javornik was discontinued. As a result, several locomotives operating there were taken out of service at Jesneice Ironworks, while the OE-II and OE-VI locomotives had their pantographs (current collectors) removed and were converted to battery power. This allowed them to continue operating on the route from Plavž to the Siemens-Martin steel plant, transporting ladles with hot material until the narrow-gauge line at ŽJ was closed on 19 April 1988. As part of the restoration, a portion of the narrow-gauge railway track was incorporated into the informational board casing for the restored OE-VI locomotive, which stands in front of SIJ Acroni’s quarto plate processing plant, formerly the Javornik rolling mill. 
SIJ Acroni chose to restore the OE-VI locomotive because of its special significance, as a testament to the valuable expertise and capabilities of their in-house specialists. Following the restoration of the small Pelton wheel in 2018, this locomotive represents their next major restoration project.**Luka Novak, a mechanical engineer in operational maintenance,** led this project. As an enthusiast for preserving technical heritage, he recounted the rich history of the locomotive: _"This locomotive is not just a few tons of iron. It represents a time when we in Jesenice had the skills to independently produce the most demanding components, including locomotives. We should remember that rail transport once played a vital role in our industry, connecting all our facilities and enabling the efficient transport of raw materials and final products. Railways were the lifeblood of our plants, and the OE-VI locomotive is living proof of this rich legacy,_ ” he said.
**Dr. Marko Mugerli from the Jesenice Upper Sava Museum (Gornjesavski muzej Jesenice)** highlighted the historical importance of narrow-gauge locomotives and their role in the steelmaking process. _“Preserving such technical monuments is essential for understanding our industrial heritage and identity. The OE-VI locomotive allows us to remember the innovation, resourcefulness, and hard work of past generations who laid the foundations for our industrial success,_ ” he emphasized. 
After the speeches, SIJ Acroni’s Managing Director mag. Branko Žerdoner, Director of the Jesenice Upper Sava Museum Aljaž Pogačnik, and restoration lead Luka Novak cut the ceremonial ribbon, symbolically making the locomotive a part of Jesenice technical heritage.

# Špela Ponomarenko Janić Becoming the Ambassador for the new Street Workout Park in Dekani nad Koprom
In addition to supporting elite sports and local sports clubs, SIJ Group is committed to promoting sports and recreation for all. Since 2015, in partnership with the Olympic Committee of Slovenia – Association of Sports Federations (OCS–ASF), we have been installing street workout parks in local communities across Slovenia to encourage active and healthy lifestyles. Until today, we have enhanced the Slovenian sports landscape with 22 quality street workout parks across 20 municipalities. This year, we marked the final days before the holiday season and the lighting of the New Year's lights with the opening of the 23rd street workout park in Dekani. 
The residents of Koper and Dekani will undoubtedly remember this year for two significant milestones: Slovenia's two Olympic medals at the Summer Olympics in Paris and, more recently, the inauguration of the 23rd street workout polygon. The opening ceremony featured its ambassador, Olympian and sprint kayaker Špela Ponomarenko Janić, who in her rich sporting career has proudly represented Slovenia's colours four times at the biggest international competition. Joining the Olympian at the ceremony were Aleš Bržan, Mayor of the Municipality of Koper; mag. Sara Wagner, Head of Corporate Communications at SIJ Group; mag. Taja Škorc, Head of Sport for All and Sport at Local Level Department at OCS–ASF; and mag. Goran Sambt, Head of the Regional Office of OCS–ASF Koper.
The event was further enhanced by a beautifully choreographed and skillfully performed dance routine by 4th- and 5th-grade students from the Dekani Primary School dance club, under the guidance of Mojca Sever, the coordinator and assistant head teacher. As a token of appreciation, young athletes received sustainable Mind of Steel bracelets. In line with SIJ Group's sustainability activities, the bracelets are made from a piece of their recycled steel and discarded shoelaces that would otherwise turn into waste and will awaken the mind of steel in the young people when they wear it every day. 
The **Mayor of the Municipality of Koper, Aleš Bržan** , emphasized that in recent years, the municipality has gained increasing recognition for its extensive sports infrastructure, which continues to be developed with significant investment. He also highlighted Koper’s recent success in sports, including the remarkable achievement of two Olympic medals at the Paris 2024 Games. “ _Koper has also become a city that is both sports-oriented and recreationally active, where physical activity is a part of our daily lives,_ ” Bržan remarked, expressing confidence that the new sports facility will be well-utilized by the community. Following the Mayor's address, **mag. Sara Wagner, Head of Corporate Communications at SIJ Group** , delivered a speech in which she shared the mission and vision behind the creation of the street workout parks network. 
_"SIJ Group has embraced the principles of the circular economy for nearly four decades. We produce steel exclusively from steel scrap, underscoring our deep commitment to sustainability. This dedication is firmly embedded in our sustainability strategy, which also extends to our partnerships in sports. Through the creation of street workout parks—designed and manufactured by us in collaboration with OCS–ASF—we aim to raise awareness of steel’s indispensable role in all aspects of life, including sports and sports infrastructure. In both sports and business, having a 'mind of steel' is crucial for achieving top results, and this has always been a core value of SIJ Group. By establishing these workout parks, we strive to inspire a 'mind of steel' in individuals and enhance the quality of life within local communities."_
On behalf of the Slovenian umbrella sports organization and a partner in the street workout parks project, **mag. Taja Škorc, Head of Sport for All and Sport at Local Level Department at OCS–ASF** , welcomed the participants of the opening ceremony and the performers in the accompanying program.
_"Thank you to the Mayor, SIJ Group, and the Koper Sports Federation for bringing us together today in this delightful setting. At the Olympic Committee of Slovenia – Association of Sports Federations, we are committed to making sports accessible to everyone. The street workout park is undoubtedly a step toward this goal. We hope that sports, especially for younger generations, will act as a counterbalance to the many distractions of modern life. I wish for this facility to fulfill its purpose for many years to come and for you to spend as much time as possible enjoying this wonderful environment,_ " Škorc said, expressing her satisfaction with the new addition to the community’s sports infrastructure. 
_"The OCS–ASF Regional Office, along with everyone involved in the sports community, wholeheartedly welcomes this new addition and initiative. I especially want to encourage all the young people in the audience to showcase the many ways we can use the workout park. Our ambassador, Špela Ponomarenko Janić, who has extensive experience with this type of training, will of course be here to assist and inspire us,_ " said **mag. Goran Sambt, Head of the Regional Office of OCS–ASF Koper** , introducing the final speaker of the opening ceremony.
_"Workout parks, like this one, are a vital part of local sports infrastructure. They are open to everyone, allowing individuals to tailor their workouts to their physical abilities. Best of all, they are completely free to use. As a young girl, I loved spending time outdoors—my favorite activity was climbing trees. I’ve noticed that in recent years, children don’t spend as much time outside as we did. I believe this workout park is a fantastic step in the right direction, encouraging children to be more active, build strength, and improve their health. For me, the play and movement I enjoyed as a child—activities we didn’t even realize were exercise—helped lay the foundation for the top results I achieved in my sporting career_ ," said **Špela Ponomarenko Janić, athlete, Olympian, and mother.**
Following the speeches, the ceremony continued with the symbolic ribbon-cutting, officially dedicating the workout park to sports enthusiasts of all generations.

# Strategic Partnership with Slovenian Steel Group is attaining great results
As we help companies on their journey to digital transformation, we have another success story. **Vladimir Arshinov, CIO of Slovenian Steel Group** , is also convinced that the partnership is a success. In his interview for Telegraf, he said: “We began the project by discussing the topic with our partners. Comtrade was flexible in their approach and was not just ready to discuss what we wanted to do but also had enough bravery to propose what they see is possible. This was a good starting point for the partnership.”
To view **the interview with Vladimir Arshinov** , check out the video below.
The digital transformation of these services will help the partner overcome some of its industry and business challenges. The key benefit is the reduction in manufacturing costs to help the company retain its competitive position.
Comtrade Solutions and SIJ are working closely to identify new projects that will enable them to be more successful in their respective fields in the future. The next steps will be related to implementing solutions to make better and faster business decisions and to optimize supply chains.
Slovenian Steel Group is one of the largest and most successful companies in Slovenia. It is a truly global corporation with distribution centers located across Europe as well as USA.

  * sustainable renewable energy: building turbines to generate energy from renewable sources such as wind, water and ground heat,
  * building nuclear reactors for existing and experimental technologies, e.g. fusion, fission.

# Living Circular Economy
At the SIJ Group, steel can be recycled again and again and processed into new types of steel without any loss of quality. We produce it entirely from steel scrap and have been living a circular economy for almost 40 years.
